# `truncating-intcast`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports `@intCast` from a wider integer binding to a narrower target, or from a
signed integer to an unsigned target, without a visible range guard.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

An out-of-range value is safety-checked illegal behavior rather than an
intentional truncation.

## When it fires

Field types declared in local structs and slice lengths written through
`std.mem.writeInt` are included.

Enable it for input conversion and protocol code where runtime values must be
validated before narrowing.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn shrink(count: u64) u32 {
    const small: u32 = @intCast(count);
    return small;
}
```
